tasks.verify_command: uv run python -c "import re; from openrouter_agent_cli.cli import SLASH_COMMANDS; text=open('README.md').read(); section=text.split('## Slash commands')[1]; missing=[c for c in SLASH_COMMANDS if c not in section]; assert not missing, f'missing: {missing}'; print('all slash commands documented')"
